versions.headline: Design system, animations, onboarding, and crash reporting.
highlights: New design system with consistent spacing, typography, and interactive states
Spring animations on panels, dropdowns, and the overlay entrance
First-launch setup flow to get started quickly
Crash detection with opt-in email reporting
What is new modal after each update

versions.headline: The global hotkey now works on GNOME Wayland, and category tabs are easier to read.
highlights: The global hotkey now works on GNOME Wayland, no Xorg session needed
The category tab scrollbar is now a thin line that no longer covers tab names
Settings now shows the SynaptCore version and warns if it needs an update

versions.headline: Clips sort themselves into categories.
highlights: Links, emails, phone numbers, file paths, colors, and code are sorted into categories automatically
Turn each automatic category on or off in Settings
Deleting a category you created now asks for confirmation

versions.headline: SynaptClip now updates itself.
highlights: SynaptClip now updates itself, with an option to check automatically
If SynaptClip crashes, details are saved to help diagnose the problem

versions.headline: See clips the moment they arrive from another device.
highlights: A popup shows clips received from your other devices, with copy and view options
Command and Option shortcuts now record correctly on macOS
Cmd+Q no longer quits SynaptClip by accident; quit from the menu bar icon instead

versions.headline: Share clipboard items between devices with Synapt.
highlights: When Synapt is running, your paired devices appear in the panel
Right-click any clip to send it to another device
Now available for Mac as a signed universal app

versions.headline: Better GNOME Wayland support and a shared tray icon.
highlights: Clipboard capture on GNOME Wayland now detects the Clipboard History extension correctly
Turn start on login on or off from Settings
SynaptClip and Synapt share a single tray icon

versions.headline: Open SynaptClip from anywhere.
highlights: Open the panel from anywhere with a global hotkey
SynaptClip starts automatically when you log in on Linux
A short setup guide on first launch

versions.headline: Settings in its own window.
highlights: Settings now opens in a separate window
The panel reopens centred on screen every time

versions.headline: Settings and themes.
highlights: A Settings page for your preferences
Choose a light or dark theme
Hover the tray icon to see SynaptClip's status

versions.headline: Search, organise, and undo.
highlights: Search your clipboard history, with typo-tolerant matching and highlighted results
Pin clips, sort them into categories, and act on many at once
Undo a deleted clip, and capture the clipboard on Wayland

versions.headline: The first SynaptClip release.
highlights: SynaptClip keeps a history of everything you copy
Search your history from a quick panel that hides when you click away
